scripts.lint: eslint packages/renderer/src packages/renderer/test packages/ui/src packages/ui/test packages/client/src packages/client/test admin/src
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bs/renderer && npm run test -w @bs/ui && npm run test -w admin
scripts.test:axe: npm run test:axe -w @bs/ui && npm run test:axe -w admin
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bs/ui && npm run build -w admin
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w admin && playwright test -c admin/playwright.config.ts
